title: Seasonal planning

title: Desert day-night temperature planning
text: Desert daytime warmth and nighttime cooling can differ, especially in cooler months. Check the forecast for the exact travel dates, pack layers and confirm how a camp handles cold, wind, rain and heating. Do not rely on a generic seasonal temperature.

title: Monsoon and protected-area access
text: Protected areas can have seasonal closures or altered access during monsoon; dates differ by reserve and can change. Check the relevant forest authority before booking transport or accommodation. Do not assume a safari is operating.

title: Birding season and water conditions
text: Birding conditions at wetlands vary with season, water and habitat. Confirm current park conditions and trail/vehicle rules. Species sightings are uncertain; avoid promises based on historic records.

title: Fort visits during hot weather
text: Schedule exposed fort walks early where possible, take shaded rest breaks, and leave the site if anyone develops signs of heat stress. Water and shade availability vary; verify site facilities and consider a shorter visit.

title: Hill-weather contingency
text: Hill weather can change visibility, road conditions and viewpoints. Check current forecast and road advisories; avoid steep or slippery paths in poor conditions and have an indoor/town alternative.

title: Seasonal crowds and events
text: Fairs, school holidays and festivals affect transport, lodging and crowd levels. Verify dates and terms before booking. Static calendars can be outdated; use organizer or official tourism information close to travel.
